text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — assigning owners for the PM postmortem actions from last week's RCA. TL;DR: 6 tickets total (infra/runtime/monitoring). Please claim what you can by EOD tomorrow so we can attach owners to the remediation sprint. Proposed claims below (feel free to reassign).

Maya Patel: Proposed list:
- RED-4821 infra: suggested owner @Ashwin Rao (R)
- RED-4824 runtime: suggested owner @Jon Kim (A)
- RED-4827 infra: suggested owner @Elena Gomez (R)
- RED-4830 monitoring: suggested owner unclaimed (C)
- RED-4833 runtime: suggested owner unclaimed (I)
- RED-4836 infra: suggested owner unclaimed (S)

Jon Kim: Can you drop the links? I'm in sprint review so will claim after that.

Maya Patel: Links: https://jira.redwood/RED-4821, https://jira.redwood/RED-4824, https://jira.redwood/RED-4827, https://jira.redwood/RED-4830, https://jira.redwood/RED-4833, https://jira.redwood/RED-4836. Also added a short acceptance criteria column in the tracker.

Elena Gomez: I'll take RED-4830 (monitoring) and do the alert tuning + dashboard. Marking as R, will add checklist. :white_check_mark:

Ashwin Rao: Taking RED-4821 and RED-4836 (infra). I'll include runbook updates and a canary plan. Assigning to myself now.

Jon Kim: I'll pick RED-4824 (runtime) but want to pair with Ashwin for the canary rollout for safety. Marking as A and will add a PR link once I have a patch.

Maya Patel: Thanks — noted claims. Still unclaimed: RED-4833 (runtime regression). We need an I/A pairing. Anyone can pick it up?

Jon Kim: I can be I (informed) for RED-4833, but not the primary owner this sprint. If no one picks it up by EOD tomorrow, I'll slot it into my follow-up list.

ops-bot: Reminder: RED-4833 has SLO impacts flagged. SLA escalation threshold crossed at 2026-03-18T14:12Z. Please ensure owner assignment within 48h.

Elena Gomez: I can take RED-4833 as backup if Jon is only informed; will do initial triage and escalate to Jon/Ashwin if it needs code changes.

Maya Patel: Perfect — final assignments then: RED-4821 Ashwin (R), RED-4824 Jon (A), RED-4827 Elena (R), RED-4830 Elena (R), RED-4833 Elena (I/R backup), RED-4836 Ashwin (R). I'll update the postmortem tracker, add RACI columns, and create the sprint cards for next cycle.

Maya Patel: Action items for owners: add acceptance criteria, link PRs, set ETA (preferably by sprint end), and add reviewers. If any owner expects >2d of work, flag for triage so we can break into sub-tasks.

Ashwin Rao: Will add runbook PRs and a small canary playbook. ETA: 3 working days for both, might split into two tickets.

Elena Gomez: I'll draft the dashboard changes and alert thresholds today. ETA: 2 days.

Jon Kim: I'll post the runtime patch PR once I finish pairing with Ashwin — aim EOD + review tomorrow.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short weekly check-in thread and a reminder before the sprint cut. Marking this thread closed for claim updates; reopen if anything changes. :lock:
